title: Strawman architecture for research to stress-test
outcome: A 1-page strawman of components + data flow + the 3 riskiest assumptions, to be confirmed or broken by Sprint 1 findings
acceptance: component diagram (text/mermaid) covering identity, recorder, monitor, containment, recovery, eval harness
explicit list of riskiest assumptions with which RES issue tests each
a proposed demo world for 10 agents
summary:
Strawman at org/adr/STRAWMAN.md (~1,200 words incl. diagram/tables).
Core: every agent call is an Ed25519-signed envelope through one Action Gateway; gateway adapters (not agents) record read/write sets with before/after values into a hash-chained JSONL recorder.
Monitor (rules + per-agent baselines) alerts with culprit-signed evidence; containment = revoke credential, quarantine at gateway, cancel in-flight, hold undispatched outbox; others keep running.
Recovery = taint graph (networkx) from recording: revert culprit writes, re-run tainted honest actions, compensate external effects, report irreversible ones.
Demo: 'Acme Mini-Co', 10 deterministic agents with deliberate crm->billing->reporter/comms dependencies; fault catalogue F1-F7; TTI/TTC/precision/recall/collateral/residual vs. a no-fault ground-truth run and two baselines.
5 riskiest assumptions mapped to RES-01..08; enterprise mapping to OTel spans, OPA/Cedar, SPIFFE/token exchange, WORM audit; 7 open questions for Call #1.
